summary: REQ-2 and REQ-3 appear implemented (required-field validation with English trap messages; submitInquiry signature matches frontend hook usage; getAllInquiries query method exists and frontend hook calls it). REQ-1 is not satisfied because inquiries are still stored in a non-stable in-memory variable, so persistence across upgrades is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Persist submitted inquiries across canister upgrades by storing inquiries in stable state (not only in-memory), so that previously submitted inquiries remain available after upgrade via the retrieval API.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows `var inquiries : [Inquiry] = [];` and no `stable var` (or explicit preupgrade/postupgrade stable persistence) is evidenced in the diff; therefore upgrade persistence is not demonstrated.

hallucinated_features.description: Frontend UI changes to show enhanced backend error messages and submission success flows on CataloguePage and ContactPage.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest focuses on backend stable persistence + backend validation + backend API surface compatibility; it does not request modifying page-level UI behavior or adding new success/error UX.
